# Score Scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](gmeow-ScoreScale.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ScoreScale>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A numeric scale for assessments — minimum, maximum, optional step. Scale arithmetic (normalization, conversion between scales) is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](gmeow-ScoreScale.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a numeric scoring scale — its minimum, maximum, and optional step — that a rubric or criterion declares for its assessments.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding normalization or scale-conversion arithmetic in triples (that is solver work — [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Mint the scale with [`gmeow:scaleMin`](../properties/gmeow-scaleMin.md) / [`gmeow:scaleMax`](../properties/gmeow-scaleMax.md) (and [`gmeow:scaleStep`](../properties/gmeow-scaleStep.md) when discrete), then attach it via [`gmeow:usesScale`](../properties/gmeow-usesScale.md) at the rubric level (default) or criterion level (override).

### Examples

- ex:zeroToOne a [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](gmeow-ScoreScale.md); [`gmeow:scaleMin`](../properties/gmeow-scaleMin.md) 0.0; [`gmeow:scaleMax`](../properties/gmeow-scaleMax.md) 1.0.
